SummaryOfFindings: The Sequential Bargaining UI integration is currently Missing. 1. Exposure Check: Missing. There is no st.sidebar.toggle or selectbox in scripts/dashboard.py that allows the user to set use_sequential_bargaining. 2. Usage Check: Missing. Since the parameter is not exposed in the UI, it is not passed to the Params object used in run_hybrid. 3. Visualization: Missing/Partial. The 'Game Tree Explorer' (Tab 2_5) renders extensive form trees which are sequential by nature, but it does not toggle its behavior or labels based on the use_sequential_bargaining parameter. It appears to be a static visualization of the subgames rather than a toggle for the simulation engine's logic.
